attempt_history.llm_sketch:
The workflow is valid. Here is the final answer:

workflow_id: wf_lf_002
steps:
  - id: receive_text
    op: extract_field
    params:
      source: request.body
      field: text_section
    output: extracted_text

  - id: validate_cors_origin
    op: apply_rule
    params:
      rule: "request.headers.origin == 'https://<username>.github.io'"
      on_fail: reject
      allowed_origin: "https://<username>.github.io"
    output: origin_valid

  - id: reject_invalid_origin
    op: handle_error
    params:
      condition: "origin_valid == false"
      error_code: 403
      message: "CORS origin not allowed"

  - id: forward_to_llm
    op: fetch_api
    params:
      method: POST
      url: "https://llm-api.example.com/v1/chat/completions"
      headers:
        Content-Type: application/json
        Authorization: "Bearer ${LLM_API_KEY}"
      body:
        model: "gpt-4o-mini"
        messages:
          - role: system
            content: >
              Tu es un assistant de nettoyage de texte français.
              Supprime les numéros de page, les en-têtes courants,
              les notes de bas de page et les artefacts de césure.
              Retourne uniquement le texte nettoyé, sans commentaire.
          - role: user
            content: "${extracted_text}"
      timeout_seconds: 30
    output: llm_raw_response

  - id: extract_cleaned_text
    op: extract_field
    params:
      source: llm_raw_response
      field: "choices[0].message.content"
    output: cleaned_text

  - id: format_response
    op: format_output
    params:
      content_type: application/json
      template:
        cleaned_text: "${cleaned_text}"
    output: api_response

  - id: log_request
    op: log_audit
    params:
      action: llm_text_cleanup
      detail: "Proxied text cleanup request; no user data retained"
      retain_data: false

  - id: return_cleaned_text
    op: call_webhook
    params:
      direction: response
      status: 200
      body: "${api_response}"
      headers:
        Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "https://<username>.github.io"
        Content-Type: application/json
    output: final_response
